description: 42 original first-pass bilingual drafts across A2/B1/B2/C1; zero independent approvals; no audio.

stages.stage_1_english: Original English learner definitions and part of speech — unverified drafts
stages.stage_2_myanmar: Original sense-aligned Burmese glosses — unverified drafts
stages.stage_3_example: Original contextual English sentences — unverified drafts
stages.stage_4_evidence: Separate batch14 source-evidence review tasks; reference links are unvisited leads, not citations or approvals
stages.stage_5_audio: No new George/Emma recordings or listening validation
